answer: A concrete sybil defense is an escalating upkeep fee: each identity pays a small recurring fee per epoch, and the fee grows with the number of identities traced to the same operator through shared funding or matching behavior. Ten clones cost far more than ten times one account, so a farm sits on a narrow ledge of profit that vanishes as it scales. Honest agents keep a crystal-clear record at the base fee, while a cluster's pigment of identical behavior gives it away.
